meta.name: miles-rl-training
meta.description: Provides guidance for enterprise-grade RL training using miles, a production-ready fork of slime. Use when training large MoE models with FP8/INT4, needing train-inference alignment, or requiring speculative RL for maximum throughput.

copy.tagline: 用 miles 框架训练大规模 MoE 强化学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 miles 做企业级 RL 训练，需要 FP8/INT4 优化
copy.tagline_en: Train large MoE RL models with miles framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if training enterprise RL models with miles, needing FP8/INT4 optimization

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 miles 框架进行大规模 MoE 模型的强化学习训练，支持 FP8/INT4 低精度训练、推测解码加速以及训练-推理对齐。
howto.when: 当你需要训练 1TB 以上的 MoE 模型（如 DeepSeek V3、Qwen3-MoE），或使用 FP8/INT4 量化感知训练，或要求训练-推理对齐时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 miles 配置一个 DeepSeek V3 的 GRPO 训练任务。
say.note: 会输出训练命令和参数建议。

say.text: 如何在 miles 中启用推测解码来加速 rollout？
say.note: 会给出 EAGLE 解码的配置步骤。

say.text: 训练时遇到 FP8 崩溃怎么办？
say.note: 会提供 block scaling 等解决方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through using the miles framework for large-scale MoE model RL training, supporting FP8/INT4 low-precision training, speculative decoding acceleration, and train-inference alignment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to train 1TB+ MoE models (e.g., DeepSeek V3, Qwen3-MoE), use FP8/INT4 quantization-aware training, or require train-inference alignment.

say_en.text: Help me configure a GRPO training task for DeepSeek V3 using miles.
say_en.note: Outputs training commands and parameter suggestions.

say_en.text: How to enable speculative decoding in miles to speed up rollout?
What to do if FP8 training collapses?
say_en.note: Offers block scaling and other solutions.
